title: "Data Dictionary"
subtitle: "Spatial layers, coordinate reference systems, and source origins"
---

::: {.callout-note}
This list catalogs data required for the 12 maps and 13 episodes described in this atlas project, along with their source origins and notes regarding how they integrate into the workshop flow.
:::

## Overview & Data Preparation

Items from the Carpentry Google Drive are downloaded as a single compressed archive by `scripts/data_prep_new.r` (or `scripts/data_prep.r`). They unpack into `source_data/`:

* **Hillshades at 3 scales and extents:**
  * Campus and the surrounding area
  * The Bight of California
  * The Western United States

---

## DEM Sources

| Dataset | Extent / Description | Source Link |
|---|---|---|
| **Western US DEM** | 90m DEM covering Western US | [ScienceBase Item](https://www.sciencebase.gov/catalog/item/542aebf9e4b057766eed286a) |
| **Bight of California DEM** | Regional elevation model | [ScienceBase Item](https://www.sciencebase.gov/catalog/item/542aebf9e4b057766eed286a) |
| **Campus DEM (`campus_DEM`)** | Local UCSB campus & Goleta Slough | UCSB Carpentry Archive |
| **Campus Topo-Bathy** | Seamless bathymetry & topography (Henley Gate to Ellwood Beach) | [USGS DS 781 (Block ID 63)](https://pubs.usgs.gov/ds/781/) |

---

## Layer Catalog by Map

### Map 1: Campus Overview
* **Coordinate Reference System:** Aligned to `campus_DEM` (NAD83 / California zone 5 / EPSG:2874 or UTM).
* **Vectors:**
  * Walkways & Campus Buildings: `Campus_Buildings.shp` (ICM via AGO circa 2017).
  * Campus Trees: UCSB Treekeeper ArcGIS Online layer.
  * Bike Paths: `bikelanescollapsedv8.shp` (`source_data/icm_bikes/bike_paths/`).
  * Wetland & Lagoon Habitats: NCOS habitat boundary shapefiles.
* **Rasters:**
  * Merged bathymetry + topography: `campus_bathotopo.tif`
  * Hillshade raster generated via `terra::shade()`.

### Map 2: Thematic Trees & Water
* Campus Trees (`DTK_012116.shp`) filtered by top 5 species and classified by height.
* Stream and lagoon network (`california_streams/streams_crop.shp`).
* Campus bikeway centerlines.

### Maps 3, 4, 5 & 6: Progressive Zoom Series
* **Map 3 (Western US):** Broad regional context with hillshade, whole degree graticule, and populated places.
* **Map 4 (Bight of California):** Regional Southern California Bight, ocean hillshade, and campus locator box.
* **Map 5 (Extended Campus):** Detailed local context with greater campus DEM, batho-topo, and hillshade.
* **Map 6 (UCSB & Environs):** Detailed base map linking regional geometry to campus bounds.

### Map 8: PlanetScope Satellite Imagery
* 4-band and 8-band PlanetScope imagery representing seasonal snapshots (Fall, Winter, Spring, Summer).
* Used for natural color (RGB) and false-color infrared visualization.

### Map 10: Vector Intersections
* Bike paths (`bikelanescollapsedv8.shp`, 2016 ICM) & California streams (`streams_crop.shp`).
* Intersection points computed via `terra::intersect()`, saved as `output_data/creek_bike_intersections.shp`.

### Map 10.5: NCOS Trail Data Provenance & Infrastructure Comparison
* **Legacy Campus Bikeways:** `source_data/icm_bikes/bike_paths/bikelanescollapsedv8.shp` — Captured from UCSB Interactive Campus Map (ICM) via ArcGIS Online circa 2016–2017. Terminates at Whittier Drive prior to NCOS restoration.
* **Modern NCOS Multi-Use Trails:** `source_data/ncos_trails/ncos_multiuse_trails.geojson` — Derived from [UCSB CCBER NCOS Public Access & Trail Map](https://www.ccber.ucsb.edu/ncos) (constructed 2018–2021). Cross-validated against CIRGIS 2020 1-foot orthophotography (`source_data/cirgis_1ft/w_campus_1ft.tif`) and OpenStreetMap (`highway=cycleway` / `path`).
* **Study Area Bounding Box:** `scripts/ncos.geojson`.
* **Restored Wetland Ground Truth:** `source_data/NCOS_Shorebird_Foraging_Habitat/`.
* **Full Stream Network:** `source_data/california_streams/California_Streams.shp`.
* **Actual Bridge Crossing Export:** `output_data/ncos_creek_crossing_actual.shp` (Devereux Creek timber bridge at 34.4204° N, 119.8770° W).

### Map 11: Dibblee Geologic Quadrangle
* Western Quadrangle: Dos Pueblos Canyon 7.5' geologic quadrangle (`source_data/09gDosPueblos/DB0009.tif`, DF-09).
* Eastern Quadrangle: Goleta 7.5' geologic quadrangle (`source_data/07gGoleta/DB0007.tif`, DF-07).
* Spliced Dividing Meridian: Longitude $-119^\circ 52' 30''\text{ W}$ ($-119.875^\circ\text{ W}$).
* Campus Area of Interest: `source_data/greater_UCSB-campus-aoi.geojson` (straddles both sheets).
* Intermediate Full-Extent GeoTIFF with AOI: `output_data/dibblee_both_tiffs_full_extent_with_aoi.tif`.
* Diagnostic Multi-Sheet Plate: `final_output/map11_both_tiffs_full_extent_aoi.png`.
* Rectified and spliced using `terra::rectify(..., method = "bilinear")` and `terra::merge()`.

### Map 12: 12-Month NDVI Phenology Stack
* Monthly PlanetScope imagery clipped to UCSB campus.
* Normalized Difference Vegetation Index:
  $$\text{NDVI} = \frac{\text{NIR} - \text{Red}}{\text{NIR} + \text{Red}}$$
* Outputs 12-month raster time series and mean NDVI seasonal profile plot.
